fields.Challenge: Challenge 6 - Severe winter smog and urban air pollution assistant
fields.Describe the changes/updates made in the: Built Breathe with real Open-Meteo/CAMS modeled outdoor air quality, timestamps, stale-data handling, household personalization, low-emission routines, indoor-air guidance, community pledges and a transparent CO2 calculator. Added server-side Gemini, secret protection, model failover, sourced safety responses and labeled fallback. Includes a sourced 30-case golden dataset, 74 passing automated tests, GitHub CI and CodeQL. All 13 selected live requests succeeded: 11 generated answers and 2 curated safety responses. Semantic review found 6 complete and 7 partial answers; this is not full accuracy certification.
fields.Mention the Gen AI services utilized in: Google Gemini API powers contextual clean-air chat using normalized household preferences, bounded conversation context and server-fetched modeled air data. Production primary model is gemini-3.1-flash-lite, with verified supported-model failover. The key stays in a Vercel Production secret. Medical-condition and other critical safety intents use explicitly labeled sourced guidance. All 13 selected live requests returned HTTP 200, including 11 actual Gemini generations; some answers omitted expected details. Open-Meteo/CAMS supplies real modeled air data and is not GenAI.
